title: Haye Imam Jafare Sadiq
body:
haye imame jafare sadiq
<<DIVIDER>>
musa kazim chaak gareban
aankhon may aansu baal parehsan
aaye hai pursa dene waale
haye imame jafare sadiq
<<DIVIDER>>
umr guzari shaah ko rote
ashkon se daaman ko bighote
sadmon ke humraah sidhaare
haye imame jafare sadiq
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid may pee kar jaam e shahadat
hogaye is dunya se ruqsat
chod ke ilm e deen ke ujaale
haye imame jafare sadiq
<<DIVIDER>>
shukr e khuda har jor o jafa par
hairaan tha mansoor sitamgar
sabr e hussain o shaan e ali thay
haye imame jafare sadiq
<<DIVIDER>>
larza hai qabre paighambar
rote hai zehra o hyder
gul hai diye sehne kaaba ke
haye imame jafare sadiq
<<DIVIDER>>
khatm hilal ab kaise hoga
shehre madina ka sannata
chup hai galiyan chup hai kooche
haye imame jafare sadiq
author: Hilal Naqvi
